title: Can Zero-Shot LLMs Predict Child Malnutrition? A Fairness and Temporal Robustness Study
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the feasibility, fairness, and temporal robustness of using a large language model to predict child malnutrition (stunting) based on public health survey data. It does not contain any components evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, morals, or ethical frameworks.
